producer_report.summary:
`athena drain` can now run the items of one plan group at the same time, up to a new `[parallel] max_concurrency` setting. The default is 1, which is the old serial loop, and values above 8 are lowered to 8. `cargo test --locked`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --all --check` all pass. I ran `cargo test --locked` once and my tool saw no failure exit. Its output was too large to display, so I could not read the per-test results of the full run. The drain tests I ran on their own passed, including all 66 in `tests/drain.rs` apart from two of my new ones, which I fixed and reran.

**What changed**
- **Setting and schema:** the schema field is `Config::parallel` in `crates/athena-data/src/config.rs`, with `#[serde(default)]` like `[landing]`, so a config without the section yields 1. The default, the ceiling (`MAX_CONCURRENCY_CEILING = 8`) and the clamp (`Parallel::workers`) are documented where defined.
- **`athena.toml`:** it gains a `[parallel]` section with `max_concurrency = 1`, added in the same change as the schema field. Without the field, `deny_unknown_fields` would make `athena.toml` fail to parse, which is what broke the earlier attempt. A test loads the real `athena.toml` through `Config`.
- **Drain loop (`drain.rs`):**
  - New `drain_parallel(steps, limits, workers, ui)`. The existing `drain()` is unchanged in signature and behavior.
  - Shared state sits behind a lock that is never held across a call into `Steps`.
  - Groups run one after another, using scoped threads, so a dependent item starts only after the group before it has finished.
  - Landing, and the rating after it, take one lock.
  - Retry rules are unchanged.
  - A stop request, the job limit, the budget or a met target stop any further item from starting. Running items finish.
  - With a bound above 1, an item that fails twice or is refused does not stop its siblings. The run ends with `repeated-failure` when its group is over.
  - Budget caps of jobs in flight are held back, so parallel jobs cannot together overspend the budget.
- **Wiring (`main.rs`):** `athena drain` reads `[parallel] max_concurrency` and calls `drain_parallel`. The help text and the module and `Report` docs no longer say the loop runs one job at a time.
- **Docs:** `plan.rs` docs, `docs/design/parallel-jobs.md` (a "first slice built" block) and `CHANGELOG.md` say what was built and what remains: multi-job `athena go` and the `--pr` phase.

**Deviations from the reading**
- I did not add a field to the `Limits` struct, because that would have broken every existing struct literal in the tests, and criterion 2 requires those tests to stay unchanged. The worker bound is a separate argument to `drain_parallel`.
- `RealSteps` now takes `ui: &(dyn Ui + Sync)` and `lander: &(dyn Lander + Sync)`.

**Unlisted files edited**
- To share `Athena` between threads, `jev::Evaluate` and `gh::HttpPost` now require `Send + Sync`. I touched `crates/athena-core/src/jev.rs` and `crates/athena-core/src/gh.rs` for this, neither of which is in the deliverables list. The test transport in `jev.rs` moved from `Rc<RefCell>` to a mutex-backed wrapper. This is the only edit beyond the listed deliverables.

checks_run.note: Exit status showed no failure. Output was too large to display and I could not read the file it was saved to (outside the working directory), so I did not see the per-test result lines.
Run before the last fixes: 64 of 66 passed, and the 2 failures were my own new tests (wrong setup, not the loop). After the fixes, the 7 new parallel tests passed when run by name.

criteria_check.criterion: A test parses the repository's athena.toml (containing a [parallel] section with max_concurrency) through Config and passes; a config without [parallel] also parses and yields max_concurrency 1. Run `cargo test`.
criteria_check.evidence: Tests `the_repository_athena_toml_parses_with_its_parallel_section` and `parallel_defaults_to_one_and_is_clamped_to_the_ceiling` in crates/athena-data/src/config.rs. The first parses the real `athena.toml`, which contains `[parallel]`. The second strips the section and checks the default is 1, and also covers an empty section, clamping to 8 and 0 becoming 1. It also checks that an unknown key such as `max_workers` is rejected. Both pass under `cargo test --locked`.

criteria_check.criterion: A drain test with a bound of 1 shows items run strictly in the existing order, and all existing drain tests pass unchanged. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli`.
criteria_check.evidence: `with_a_bound_of_one_items_run_strictly_one_at_a_time_in_the_existing_order` shows run order a, b, c with a peak of 1 in flight. Its log and report equal those of `drain::drain` on the same queue. No existing test was edited, and all 64 earlier drain tests passed in `cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test drain`.

criteria_check.criterion: A drain test with a bound of 2 and two independent items in one group has both in flight at once (barrier; fails if serial), and an item that depends on another starts only after it finishes. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli`.
criteria_check.evidence: `with_a_bound_of_two_independent_items_are_in_flight_together_and_a_dependent_starts_after`. The stub holds `a` and `b` until two runs are in flight, with a 3 s timeout. The test asserts a peak of 2, which a serial loop cannot reach. It also asserts `start c` comes after both `end a` and `end b`.

criteria_check.criterion: A test shows one item's failure or refusal does not stop its siblings, the worker bound is never exceeded, and Stop starts no further item. Run `cargo test`.
criteria_check.evidence: `one_items_failure_does_not_stop_its_siblings_and_the_bound_is_never_exceeded` has 5 items and 2 workers. It asserts a peak of exactly 2, 4 landed, and `repeated-failure` naming `a`. `a_refused_item_does_not_stop_its_siblings` checks that the siblings still run. `a_stop_request_starts_no_further_item_but_lets_the_running_ones_finish` checks that only the two items in flight ran, that both landed, and that the stop is `Requested`. `jobs_in_flight_hold_their_caps_so_parallel_jobs_cannot_overspend_the_budget` and `the_job_limit_holds_with_several_workers` cover the budget and the job limit.

criteria_check.criterion: Ordering and retry rules are unchanged, and `cargo test`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check` all pass.
criteria_check.evidence: The retry loop (`ATTEMPTS = 2`, re-read on retry) and the plan order are untouched. The failure test checks that `start a-retry` happens. fmt --check and clippy -D warnings exit cleanly, and `cargo test --locked` showed no failure exit.

criteria_check.criterion: athena.toml gains a [parallel] section only together with its schema field in crates/athena-data/src/config.rs; the field, default (1) and ceiling are documented where defined, and the athena.toml change is named and justified in the final report.
criteria_check.evidence: `Config::parallel`, `Parallel::max_concurrency` and `MAX_CONCURRENCY_CEILING` have doc comments in config.rs. The `athena.toml` change is justified in the summary above and named in CHANGELOG.md as a governance path change.

criteria_check.criterion: Drain module docs and Report docs no longer say the loop runs one job at a time; docs/design/parallel-jobs.md and CHANGELOG.md say what this slice built and what remains (multi-job `athena go`, --pr phase). The final report maps each criterion to its evidence.
criteria_check.evidence: I rewrote the module doc and the `Report::plan_groups` doc in drain.rs, the `plan.rs` module doc, and the drain help text in main.rs. A "first slice built" block went into parallel-jobs.md, and an Added entry into CHANGELOG.md. Both list multi-job `athena go` and the `--pr` phase as not built. This table maps each criterion to its evidence.

open_issues: Whether several `Athena::go` calls in one process are safe against the records on disk is not tested beyond the stub-based drain tests, and the real parallel path has no end-to-end test. Worth reviewing before setting max_concurrency above 1 in athena.toml.
Landing is serialized by an in-process lock only. Two separate drain processes are not coordinated by it.
I could not read the full `cargo test --locked` output (too large, and I could not read the saved file). The pass result rests on the exit status and on the drain test runs I did read.
mistakes: My first two parallel tests had wrong setup: the stop test let `a` set the stop before `b` started, and the budget test ignored that a job's reservation shrinks after its read. I fixed both and they pass.
I first wrote a garbled assertion in the refused-item test. I replaced it before running.
learnings: Config in crates/athena-data/src/config.rs uses deny_unknown_fields, and a test embeds the real athena.toml (REPO_CONFIG), so a TOML section without a schema field fails the build.

`Athena` was not Sync only because `jev::Evaluate` and `gh::HttpPost` (the Jev client's transport) lacked Send + Sync. All real implementors were already thread-safe, and only one test transport used Rc/RefCell.
plan.rs's `Plan::groups` are consecutive waves, so running groups in order respects dependencies.
docs/design/parallel-jobs.md section 5 names the planned setting `parallel.max_workers`; the built name follows the request: `max_concurrency`.
`drain::Limits` is built as a struct literal in many tests, so adding a field to it breaks them.
desires: A way to read a persisted large command output inside the working directory, or a quieter test mode, to confirm the full-suite result line.
